ctf_definitions.layouts: shared d_j=(j-floor((n-1)/2))*w_b (primary; sprayer on a base lane; even n: edge lane added on the side without a neighbour pass); centred d_j=(j-(n-1)/2)*w_b (sensitivity). d measured along the canonical normal of the pass chord.
ctf_definitions.B3c: rho = r_ctf + d_max; clearance half-width h_env = max(w_s/2, d_max + w_b/2) for every obstacle (class I for the lanes); set corners eps = max(m + h_env, rho); hard set obstacle + B(h_env)
ctf_definitions.B3n: B3c plus nesting: neighbour pass on the bulge side avoids conv(bump) + B(c_sep), c_sep = max(w_s - w_b + s_min, r_ctf + d_max), forced side, iterated to a fixed point; depth = nested passes per obstacle group
ctf_definitions.variants: B3c, B3n (s_min), B3n_s12 (s_min_sens), B3n_k2 (B3n with chains stopped after nest_k pushed passes); even n also B3c_ctr, B3n_ctr with the centred-layout d_max
ctf_definitions.lane_valid: no cusp (1 - d*kappa <= 0 anywhere), lane simple, min radius >= r_ctf*(1-radius_tol); kappa from tangent angle change over curv_window on a curv_ds resampling. *_seeder_*: same with r_min_seeder
ctf_definitions.lane_clear_tool_min_m: min over lanes/obstacles dist(lane, obstacle) - w_b/2 (ground-engaging tool, all obstacles); n_clear_fail_lanes counts lanes < 0
ctf_definitions.spacing: nearest other swath lane, sampled every 2 m excluding w_b/2 at lane ends; squeeze < w_b-0.5, gap > w_b+0.5 (length, m); lane_squeeze_share_pct = share of sampled lane length with spacing < 0.75 w_b
ctf_definitions.network: swath lanes (+B2 corridor lanes) + base-machine headland rings at (i+0.5) w_b filling the k*w_s band of the strategy's cells (outer boundary and B1/B2 holes)
ctf_definitions.n_lane_overlaps: pairs of lanes within 0.5 m of each other for > 24 m (duplicated tramline)
ctf_definitions.n_lane_breaks: tramline stops = round(lane ends farther than k*w_s + w_b from the paddock boundary / 2) + lanes with tool clearance < 0 (they must stop at the obstacle)
ctf_definitions.off_lane: mean over the two wheels (gauge) of wheel-line length farther than off_lane_tol from network wheel tracks
ctf_definitions.trafficked: raster traffic_res, tyre_width footprints; unique_trafficked_ha = sprayer path + headland passes + all lane wheel tracks; _season adds the Part-3 seeder and harvester turns
ctf_definitions.sown: simulate_coverage with the w_b seeder along all lanes + base headland rings; *_sc_* with seeder_sections
ctf_definitions.part3: subset part3_filter, every width; strategies except A; RP_RoutePlannerBase from the gate projected on the strategy's mid headland, GLS part3_rp_time s; PP DubinsCC; robot w_b, r_min per machine, same speeds as the sprayer; time = (lanes + base headland rings)/cruise + turns/turn_vel; harvester has no SC
